alerts.approveBssid: Этот BSSID наш: одобрите его, и ложные оповещения об этом радиомодуле прекратятся
alerts.impostorRuleDesc: Оповещать, когда неизвестная радиоточка вещает имя сети из вашего парка. Отключите, если ваши точки доступа вне NetPulse (UniFi, Omada...) дают ложные срабатывания.

hints.agent-down: Проверьте питание роутера и его подключение. Если связь не восстановится, переустановите агента из LuCI.
hints.agent-down-ssh: Проверьте питание роутера и его подключение. Если связь не восстановится, переустановите агента из LuCI.
hints.agent-outdated: Обновите агента из "Настроек", раздел "Агенты" (кнопка "Обновить"). Если это панель NetGrip, обновите из её собственной панели.
hints.degraded-link: Проверьте кабель и коннекторы. Деградация линка часто означает повреждённый кабель или плохой контакт в коннекторе.
hints.device-offline: Проверьте питание устройства и сетевой кабель.
hints.router-offline: Проверьте питание устройства и сетевой кабель.
hints.firmware-outdated: Для вашего роутера доступна более новая прошивка. Загляните в "Обновления прошивок" (Labs) или в LuCI.
hints.gateway-unreachable: Проверьте связь между шлюзом и остальной сетью.
hints.ghost-port: Проверьте кабель и подключённое устройство. Активный порт, который замолчал, обычно означает отошедший кабель или выключенное устройство.
hints.high-temperature: Улучшите вентиляцию и уберите роутер подальше от источников тепла.
hints.port-flapping: Проверьте кабель или порт коммутатора: обычно виновато нестабильное соединение.
hints.unknown-device: Если вы его не узнаёте, заблокируйте устройство или отметьте как доверенное в настройках.
hints.new-client: Устройство впервые появилось в сети. Если вы его узнаёте, дайте ему имя или отметьте как доверенное в настройках. Если нет, разберитесь, что это.
hints.wifi-ssid-impostor: Неизвестная радиоточка вещает имя вашей сети. Осмотрите зону вокруг слушающей точки доступа. Если вы не узнаёте этот BSSID, считайте её чужой точкой.
hints.new-neighbor-ssid: Новое имя сети вещает по соседству уже несколько часов. Если это не ваша сеть, выясните, что это: новый роутер, IoT-устройство в режиме сопряжения или чей-то хотспот. Если это постоянный сосед, который вам не мешает, закройте оповещение. Оно не повторится.
hints.uplink-switched: Проверьте линию, по которой пропала связь. Роутер сам вернётся на неё, когда она восстановится.
hints.wan-down: Проверьте модем или ONT. Если пропадание связи продолжается, обратитесь к провайдеру.
hints.wan-slow: Перезагрузите роутер и модем или ONT и повторите тест. Если скорость остаётся низкой, обратитесь к провайдеру: деградация линии или перегрузка в вашем районе.
hints.wifi-weak: Перенесите клиент ближе к точке доступа или передвиньте саму точку.
hints.snmp-failing: Проверьте SNMP community string и порт коммутатора: устройство отвечает на ping, но не на опрос SNMP.

integrations.emptyDesc: Добавьте внешний пушер для роутера, до которого NetPulse не может добраться напрямую.
integrations.unmanagedDesc: Эти пушеры передают данные о парке, но у них нет записи интеграции, поэтому NetPulse не может их запустить, остановить или сменить их токен. Они установлены вручную: чтобы сменить токен или пин сертификата, отредактируйте их env-файл на хосте.

confirm.confirmDeleteDesc: Удалить интеграцию {{slug}}? Её пушер будет остановлен, если он работает.

form.fieldSlugInvalid: Используйте строчные буквы, цифры и дефисы

form.fieldIntervalInvalid: Интервал должен быть от 10 до 86400 секунд
form.modeLocalHint: Этот пушер работает на хосте NetPulse.
form.modeSshHint: В режиме SSH пушер устанавливается внутри роутера.

help.title: Quick guide
help.subtitle: Walkthroughs for the tasks a first-day admin actually needs, quoting the buttons exactly as they appear in the app.
help.docsFooter: This guide lives inside the app and quotes the real interface labels, so it always matches the version you are running.

firstLogin.title: First run and password
firstLogin.subtitle: Sign in for the first time and secure the admin account
firstLogin.intro: The first admin user is created at server startup from the AUTH_PASS variable in .env; from then on the hash stored in the database is what counts.
steps: Open the app and sign in with the admin user and the bootstrap password.
Go to ⟦Settings⟧ → ⟦Change my password⟧: it asks for your current password and the new one (10 to 128 characters). Your other sessions are signed out when it changes.
If you like, install NetPulse as an app from ⟦Settings⟧ → ⟦Install app⟧.
firstLogin.tip: Create read-only users for anyone who just needs to look, from the users section in ⟦Settings⟧.

addRouter.title: Onboard a router or switch
addRouter.subtitle: Add a unit to the fleet
addRouter.intro: Fleet units are managed from Settings, not from the fleet page: onboarding, editing and network discovery live there.
steps: Go to ⟦Settings⟧ → the ⟦Fleet⟧ section and click ⟦Add unit⟧.
Fill in IP or hostname, name and type. Tick ⟦Is the gateway⟧ for the gateway; pick the matching type for managed switches.
For the server to poll over SSH, authorize its key: copy it from ⟦Server SSH key⟧ and install it on the router.
You can also click ⟦Discover on the network⟧ to detect candidates automatically.
addRouter.tip: A switch or AP without SSH can run in ⟦Agent only (no SSH)⟧ mode: all data will arrive through the agent.

installAgent.title: Install the agent on a router
installAgent.subtitle: The recommended path for complete data
installAgent.intro: The agent probes the router locally (WiFi, DHCP, FDB, LLDP) and pushes the data to the server; without it the client list stays empty.
steps: Go to ⟦Fleet⟧ and scroll to the ⟦Agents⟧ section: every OpenWrt router has a row, agent or not.
Click ⟦Install agent⟧ on the router's row: it registers the token and deploys over SSH (binary, config, service and watchdog) in one click if the SSH key is already authorized.
Within seconds the router shows as online in that same table. ⟦Reinstall⟧ repeats the whole process and is what keeps the agent alive across firmware upgrades.
Manual path, or a version without the button? ⟦Settings⟧ → ⟦Agent adoption⟧ → ⟦Show token⟧, then run install-agent.sh with --pairing-token from a machine with SSH access to the router.
installAgent.tip: The pairing token is reusable for several routers until you rotate it with ⟦Rotate token⟧; each agent trades it for its own token on first contact.

channelPlan.title: Read the channel plan
channelPlan.subtitle: Pick the WiFi channel with the least interference
channelPlan.intro: The page collects the passive neighbour scans pushed by the agents and scores each channel; the recommendation balances your current channel against the candidates.
steps: Open ⟦Channels⟧ in the menu.
Pick the router: each radio shows its current channel, the neighbours it hears and the score of every candidate channel.
The highlighted recommendation is the channel with the least overlap; compare it with the current channel before touching anything.
channelPlan.tip: Scans arrive with the agent pushes: if a router reports no neighbours, check that its agent is online.

firmware.title: Upgrade a router's firmware
firmware.subtitle: Controlled flash with verification and backup
firmware.intro: The server tells the agent which image to flash; the agent downloads it, verifies the sha256, backs up the config and flashes with sysupgrade.
steps: Open ⟦Firmware upgrades⟧ in the menu (labs, admin only).
Pick the router: the form preloads the detected system (model and current version). Paste the image URL and its sha256.
Click ⟦Upgrade now⟧: the confirmation summarises router, target version, URL and checksum, and warns about the downtime while it reboots.
Follow the progress on the same page; the final result lands when the router finishes booting.
firmware.tip: After a flash only /etc survives: the agent's self-heal restores the binary at boot, and ⟦Reinstall⟧ puts everything fresh if needed.

proxmoxToken.title: Connect a Proxmox cluster
proxmoxToken.subtitle: Create the read-only API token the integration asks for
proxmoxToken.intro: The Proxmox integration seals each host as a hypervisor and hangs its CTs and VMs under it in ⟦Fleet⟧, with real names and IPs. It only needs read access: an API token with audit permissions.
steps: In the Proxmox web UI go to ⟦Datacenter⟧ → ⟦Permissions⟧ → ⟦API Tokens⟧ and create a token for the user of your choice (e.g. root@pam!netpulse).

Grant audit permissions: under ⟦Permissions⟧ → ⟦Add⟧ assign the PVEAuditor role on path / to the token (if the token has privilege separation, the permission must belong to the token itself - the user's own is not enough).
In NetPulse open ⟦Settings⟧ → ⟦Services⟧ and click the configure icon of ⟦Proxmox VE⟧: add the cluster URL (https://host:8006), the Token ID (user@realm!name) and the Secret.
Click ⟦Test⟧: if the token authenticates but sees no guests, it is missing the permissions from step 2.
proxmoxToken.tip: The secret is sent only once and never comes back from the server: to change it, edit the instance and type the new one.

mqtt.title: Connect Home Assistant (MQTT)
mqtt.subtitle: Network sensors in Home Assistant, discovered on their own
mqtt.intro: NetPulse publishes the fleet state to an MQTT broker and Home Assistant automatically discovers one device with the network health and one per router.
steps: Go to ⟦Settings⟧, ⟦Integrations⟧ section, and open the ⟦MQTT / Home Assistant⟧ row.
Fill in ⟦Broker⟧ (the broker IP, e.g. your Home Assistant host), ⟦Port⟧ (1883 by default), ⟦Username⟧ and ⟦Password⟧ if the broker requires them.
Name the ⟦Instance⟧ (e.g. home) and adjust the ⟦Publish interval (s)⟧ if you need to.
Press ⟦Test connection⟧ to check it, enable ⟦Enabled⟧ and save.
Nothing to configure in Home Assistant: MQTT discovery creates the sensors (health, clients, CPU, memory, temperature, alerts) as soon as the first message arrives.
mqtt.tip: The broker connection has no TLS: use it inside your local network or against a broker on the same machine. This same setting also propagates the configuration to routers running NetGrip.

ntfy.title: Push notifications with ntfy
ntfy.subtitle: Urgent alerts on your phone or desktop
ntfy.intro: ntfy delivers urgent alerts to mobile and desktop apps using your own server or ntfy.sh, without relying on third parties.
steps: Go to ⟦Settings⟧, ⟦Notifications⟧ section, and open the ⟦Push notifications via ntfy⟧ row.
Fill in ⟦Server⟧ (https://ntfy.sh or your server URL) and a long, random ⟦Topic⟧.
If the topic is reserved, also add the ⟦Access token⟧.
Enable ⟦Enabled⟧, save and press ⟦Test⟧: a test notification should arrive.
Install the ntfy app on your phone and subscribe to the same topic.
ntfy.tip: The topic works as a password: anyone who knows it receives the notifications. Only urgent alerts are sent.

telegram.title: Telegram alerts
telegram.subtitle: Alert where you already are
telegram.intro: A Telegram bot forwards urgent alerts to a private or group chat. You only need to create the bot once.
steps: In Telegram, talk to @BotFather, create a bot with /newbot and copy the token it gives you.
Send /start to your new bot: otherwise it cannot message you.
Go to ⟦Settings⟧, ⟦Notifications⟧ section, and open the ⟦Notifications to the Telegram bot⟧ row.
Paste the token into ⟦Bot token⟧ and your chat ID into ⟦Chat ID⟧.
Enable ⟦Enable Telegram notifications⟧ and press ⟦Send test⟧.
telegram.tip: To alert a group, add the bot to the group and use that chat's ID (it starts with -). Your own user ID can be checked with @userinfobot.

mcp.title: AI assistants (MCP)
mcp.subtitle: Your instance, queryable with read-only tools
mcp.intro: The MCP server exposes an endpoint at /mcp so AI assistants can query the fleet, per-router health, devices, WireGuard, AdGuard, topology and alerts. All read-only.
steps: The endpoint must be enabled on the server: add NETPULSE_MCP_ENABLED=1 to the service environment (e.g. the .env next to the binary) and restart. If it is missing, the dialog itself tells you.
Go to ⟦Settings⟧, ⟦Integrations⟧ section, and open the ⟦MCP — AI assistants⟧ row.
Enable ⟦Endpoint /mcp active⟧.
Create a token with the manager built into the dialog.
In your assistant, configure a remote MCP server with the URL http://IP:port/mcp and the token as a Bearer credential.
mcp.tip: The tools are read-only and every call is logged in the server journal. Revoke the token when you stop using it.

integrations.title: Connect integrations
integrations.subtitle: Units that cannot be polled over SSH
integrations.intro: A pusher is a small binary that runs where the unit is and sends its data to NetPulse. Every vendor ships as its own executable, so you only download the code for hardware you own.
steps: Open ⟦Settings⟧ and find the ⟦Add-ons⟧ group.
Turn on ⟦External agents⟧ and press its gear to open the integrations manager.
Pick the vendor from the catalog: asuswrt, bbox, opnsense, routeros or unifi, among others.
NetPulse deploys the pusher, starts it and lets you edit its settings and token from the same dialog.
A unit that was already pushing without a record shows up under ⟦Managed outside NetPulse⟧ with its version and last push: NetPulse cannot start it or rotate its token.

certificates.title: Install your certificate
certificates.subtitle: HTTPS with your own certificate or CA
certificates.intro: The HTTPS card in Settings accepts your own certificate or one issued by your CA. The pair is validated before the listener is touched, so a broken certificate does not take the instance down.
steps: Open ⟦Settings⟧ and go to the ⟦HTTPS⟧ card.
Choose the source: ⟦private CA⟧ or ⟦own pair⟧.
Point to the certificate and key paths, and give the password when the key is encrypted.
Apply: NetPulse loads the pair and restarts the listener; if the new one does not start, it rolls back.
Agents pin the leaf key, so after changing it they have to be paired again.
Under ⟦Additional options⟧ you can re-issue the connection strings and decide what plain HTTP is still allowed to do.
